core_quality_metrics.group_recall_at_k: fraction of evidence groups with at least one acceptable selected memory; identical to the existing group_coverage
core_quality_metrics.evidence_member_recall_at_k: fraction of the union of acceptable evidence memories selected
core_quality_metrics.evidence_member_precision_at_k: fraction of selected memories in the union of acceptable evidence memories
core_quality_metrics.exact_task_success_rate: fraction of queries for which every evidence group is covered; identical to all_groups_covered

agent_handoff: the selected B-memory set is the retrieval output; no downstream reranker or answer-accuracy evaluator was executed
